title: FREEMAX MAXUS PRO TANK METAL EDITION (M PRO 2 TANK)
description:
FreeMax MAXUS Pro Metal Tank features a Child Resistant ‘slide-to-open’ top-fill system and is CRC qualified. It introduces the 904L M Series Mesh Coils and adopts the advanced FM COILTECH4.0, incorporating military-grade SS904L mesh and tea fiber cotton for enhanced stability and rich flavors. The tank is also certified as Child Resistant (ISO8317) for its top-fill mechanism, ensuring safety and ease of use.
What’s in the Box?
Includes:
• 1 x Maxus Pro Tank Metal Edition (904L M2 Mesh Coil 0.2ohm)
• 1 x Extra 904L M1 Mesh 0.15Ω Coil
• 1 x Extra 5mL Replacement Glass Tube
• 1 x Extra O-Ring
• 1 x User Manual
Freemax Maxus Pro Tank Metal Edition (M Pro 2 Tank) Features and Specifications:
• Size: 59.35mm x 28.2mm
• Capacity: 5mL
• Weight: 77.8g
• Material: SS904L / Tea Fiber Cotton / SS / Resin
• Thread: 510
• Drip Tip: 810
